sources: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 1835 (Main and North loops, all 18 campsites parsed)

values.note: ReserveAmerica or 1-800-456-2267, up to 9 months ahead; same-day reservations until 3 pm on the day of arrival, and walk-ins are permitted on campsites. Campsites have a 1-night minimum all season (cabins 2 nights). Maximum 14 continuous nights, then 48 hours away before registering again.

booking.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/newtown-battlefield-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=1835 ('Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 9 Month(s) in advance'; 'Same-day reservations are allowed until 3 p.m. on day of arrival; this applies to campsites only ... Walk-ins are permitted on campsites only'; 'Cabins have a 2-night minimum stay and campsites have a 1-night minimum stay - all season'; LENGTH OF STAY 'maximum of 14 continuous nights ... must leave the site and facility for 48 hours'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 18 campsites, all back-in: the two electric sites 17E and 18E (Main Loop) are listed at 40 ft, North Loop sites 13-16 at 35 ft, and the other 12 at 20 ft. Plus 5 cabins.

sites.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/newtown-battlefield-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=1835 ('Campsite (18)', 'Cabin (5)') + ReserveAmerica site list ('40 Back-In' 017E, 018E; '35 Back-In' 013-016; '20 Back-In' 001-012), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 1835 (017E and 018E 'Electric Hookup available: 30 amp'; the other 16 'Electric Hookup - no'; all 'Full Hookup - no'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/newtown-battlefield-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=1835 ('Park amenities include cabins, campsites, showers, dumping stations'; Services and Amenities 'Dump Station', 'Showers', 'Water Fillup Station'), read 2026-10-21

note: OPRHP hilltop park SE of Elmira. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on ReserveAmerica (parkId 1835): reservable, showers, dump, phone 607-732-6067, 2027 season May 21 - Oct 10 with the North Loop from May 28 (matches the manual season). Changed sites 28 -> 18 (RA 'Campsite (18)'). Added 9-month window, 14-night max, 1-night campsite minimum, max 40 ft (2 sites; all back-in), electric 30 amp (2 sites), water fill station. Fees left as read 2026-10-12. Note trimmed of field facts and the wrong '~28 sites' / 'North Loop 10 to ~35 ft'.
flags: Criteria margin: only 6 of 18 campsites take a 23-ft rig - the electric sites 17E and 18E (40 ft) and North Loop 13-16 (35 ft); the other 12 are listed at 20 ft.
